title: Book One · Chapter 63: A Name Said Too Fast
story:
On Tuesday morning, Mum takes Ronan to school. First she stops at Mr Han's gate. She says, “Mrs Gao received the envelope last night.” Mr Han thanks her. He will tell the other man too. That man carried the envelope. Mum can bring the longer written address later.

At school, Leo wants to hear everything.

Ronan tells him about the gate and the six doors. He tells him about the address slip. Leo asks, “Did anything fall on your head?” Now Ronan remembers the red sock.

“Only a sock.”

“That is enough.”

They laugh. Then Leo grows serious.

“So the man did take it to the wrong place.”

“Yes.”

“I knew he was lazy.”

Ronan looks at him. Ronan made a guess about the man too. They could not find the envelope then.

“Mum says the address was not clear.”

“He could still ask.”

“So could we.”

Leo pulls a loose thread from his sleeve. “I did ask you.”

“You asked, ‘Did he keep the money?’”

Leo looks away.

Two other children are at the next desk. One turns his head. Ronan lowers his voice.

“The money was still there.”

“I know.”

Miss Wu comes in with a pile of books. She puts them down too hard. The top book slides onto the floor.

“Please help me with these,” she says. “I have two hands and far too many books.”

The boys get up. Ronan takes five books. Leo takes six, then gives one back when the pile bends.

During writing time, Miss Wu asks them to make one clear sentence about a place.

Leo writes about the school gate. Ronan writes about East Court. He leaves a gap in his sentence. He cannot write the word entrance yet.

“You know some easier words,” Miss Wu tells him. “Use those. How can I find the gate?”

He writes: The gate is beside the tea shop.

Miss Wu reads it. “That helps me.”

After school, the boys stop at Mr Qiu's stall. Leo takes longer than usual to choose a pencil. He looks at the road three times.

“What are you looking for?” Mr Qiu asks.

“The other man. He carried Mr Han's envelope.”

“He passed this morning.”

Leo presses the pencil against his thumb.

“I said something about him.”

Mr Qiu waits.

“I was not sure about it.”

“Then you can say that when you see him.”

“I cannot find him now.”

“No. He has work to do.”

Ronan is surprised. Mr Qiu gives such a simple answer. The boys changed their minds about the man. But the man still has his own work to do.

Mr Qiu takes a piece of paper from under the counter. He writes the full address for his own notes.

“People ask me for places,” he says. “I would rather give them the right one.”

Leo leans forward. “Put the tea shop on it.”

“I shall.”

“And the white stones.”

Mr Qiu adds those too. Leo watches until the pencil stops.

Leo buys his pencil. Ronan has no money to spend today. He helps Mr Qiu put two loose rulers back in a cup.

At the corner, Leo says, “Do not tell everyone.”

Ronan thinks of the child at the next desk.

“I will tell them the envelope arrived. I will not repeat your guess about the man.”

Leo nods. Then he holds up the new pencil.

“Race you to the next tree?”

“Walking race. Mum said no running near the carts.”

They walk very fast. Leo wins by half a shoe. For once, he does not say he was much faster.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- lowers his voice＝他放低声音
- clear sentence＝清楚的句子
- passed＝经过了
- changed their minds＝改变了想法

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：stall＝小摊；repeat＝再说一遍。

## 读句提示

**How can I find the gate?**

我怎样能找到那扇门？这是直接问句，不嵌在tell me后。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么想找送信封的人？
2. Ronan决定向同学说明什么，又保留什么？
